description: Create a new invoice in Lexware; finalize=true creates status "open", false or omitted creates a draft, and the API cannot finalize an existing draft. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

body.description: Invoice JSON body with voucherDate, address (contactId or manual fields), lineItems (name, quantity, unitPrice), totalPrice, and taxConditions. In introduction, lineItems[].description, and remark, use only Lexware formatting: **bold**, __italic__, and dash-prefixed list items separated by newlines.

finalize.description: When true, creates the invoice in finalized "open" status. When false or omitted, creates as draft. Maps to the documented ?finalize=true query parameter.

name: lexware_create_invoice
title: Create Invoice
